EXECUTIVE SUMMARY 
Senior Programe Manager with 13+ years of experience driving large scale business change and transformation programes across 
BFSI and financial services. Known for leading complex, multi-workstream programs within financial crime, compliance, and regulatory 
transformation landscapes, managing senior stakeholder relationships, and delivering strategic business change initiatives on time and 
within scope. 
Brings deep expertise in programe governance, dependency and risk management, business case development, executive 
presentation, and investment prioritization across complex banking transformation environments. Strong background in financial crime 
prevention including fraud risk management at NPCI and RBL Bank, providing direct domain adjacency to CLM, CDD, KYC, and AML 
transformation programes. Experienced in coordinating across compliance, technology, operations, and business workstreams 
simultaneously in regulated banking environments including Mastercard, NPCI, and RBL Bank. 
Seeking a Senior Programe Manager role within a global financial institution where business change leadership, CLM and CDD 
transformation governance, and senior stakeholder management are at the core.
